newsitem.title: USA: HL&P shuts South Texas nuclear plant.
newsitem.headline: HL&P shuts South Texas nuclear plant.

text.p: Houston Lighting and Power Co (HL&P) shut its 1,250 megawatt (MW) South Texas 2 nuclear power plant, the Nuclear Regulatory Commission (NRC) said Thursday.
The unit, which was not scheduled for maintenance, was currently in "hot standby," the NRC said in its daily status report.
"We had a turbine trip and then a reactor trip Wednesday at about 1556 (CST). We are still investigating the cause (of the outage)," said company spokesman John Taylor.
He said the company had no exact restart time for the unit, but said it likely would be back on line in two to three days.
The unit, in Palacios, Texas, was producing at full power early Wednesday.
